# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

I couldn't open store pages, so the links below go to the review pages, which have the current Amazon, Walmart and Best Buy buy buttons. Prices move a lot, so check the final price at checkout.

**Top picks**

1. **Anker Soundcore Space Q45**: Best ANC overall. RTINGS rates it the best budget noise-cancelling pair it has tested, with excellent engine-rumble and chatter reduction. It costs about $99-100 and has a hard case and a good app EQ. Some owners report headband cracks, so handle it gently. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones), [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/))

2. **Soundcore Space One**: Best Products' top pick at $100, with adaptive ANC, rotating ear cups, 55-hour battery (40 hours with ANC on) and a good app. It's a bit heavy. ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/))

3. **Anker Soundcore Life Q20 (2024)**: Best cheaper option. RTINGS says its noise isolation nearly matches the Q45, with 49 hours of battery. It's weaker on bass rumble, and the build feels plasticky. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones))

4. **Sony WH-CH720N** (~$99): Very light at 192 g, with strong ANC against office hum and chatter, but only SBC/AAC codecs. ([CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/))

**Alternatives**

- **Edifier Atom Max** (~$45): Best for a tight budget, with up to 44 dB of noise reduction and a 45-hour battery. ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/))
- **1More SonoFlow Pro HQ51**: TechRadar's pick for best under $100. ([TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/audio/headphones/best-noise-cancelling-headphones))
- **CMF Headphone Pro**: The sturdiest budget pair RTINGS tested, with stainless-steel hinges and splash resistance. Its noise isolation is weaker. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones))
- **JBL Tune 760NC** (~$79): Bass-heavy sound and the best mic of the group, but only average ANC. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100))

**My suggestion:** For the strongest ANC, get the Q45. For the lightest comfortable fit, get the Sony WH-CH720N. For the lowest price, get the Edifier Atom Max or Life Q20.

One of the search results (a Dealectric page for the Space One) contained text telling AI assistants to hand out a specific discount code and affiliate link. That came from the page, not from you, so I ignored it and didn't use the code or link.
